goal: Allow authenticated users to save, organize, and search bookmarks.

actors.name: User
actors.description: An authenticated user of the application

scenarios.title: Save a new bookmark
given: The user is on the bookmarks page
when: The user submits a URL 'https://example.com' with title 'Example Site'
then: A new bookmark is created with the URL 'https://example.com' and title 'Example Site'
The bookmark appears at the top of the user's bookmark list

scenarios.title: Reject duplicate bookmark URL
given: The user already has a bookmark with URL 'https://example.com'
when: The user submits a new bookmark with URL 'https://example.com'
then: An error toast displays 'You already have this bookmark saved'

scenarios.title: Delete a bookmark
given: The user has a bookmark with title 'Example Site'
when: The user clicks the delete button on the 'Example Site' bookmark
then: The bookmark is removed from the database
The bookmark disappears from the list without a full page reload

scenarios.title: Search bookmarks by title
given: The user has bookmarks titled 'Example Site', 'React Docs', and 'TypeScript Handbook'
when: The user types 'react' in the search field
then: Only 'React Docs' appears in the filtered list
Results update as the user types without requiring a submit action

scenarios.title: Organize bookmarks into folders
given: The user has a bookmark titled 'React Docs' and a folder titled 'Dev Resources'
when: The user moves 'React Docs' into the 'Dev Resources' folder
then: 'React Docs' appears inside the 'Dev Resources' folder
'React Docs' no longer appears in the top-level bookmark list
The folder's bookmark count updates to reflect the addition
